title: Pinned derived tensor adjunction on singles in any integer degree
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes with the shared derived categories of structure-module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $q\in\mathbf Z$, $N$ be a module on $S$, $M$ a module on $T$, and $b:g^*N\to M$ a module morphism. Write $S_X^q$ for the single complex in degree $q$ and $c_{g,q,N}:Lg^*(S_S^qN)\to S_T^q(g^*N)$ for the comparison defined from the pinned left-derived counit [lem-weil-pbc-derived-pullback-top-cohomology]. Define $u_{g,q,M}:S_S^q(g_*M)\to Rg_*(S_T^qM)$ as the localization of the inverse termwise single/direct-image comparison followed by the selected right-derived unit [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Under the pinned derived adjunction of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], the transpose of $c_{g,q,N}\,S_T^q(b)$ is $S_S^q(\operatorname{adj}(b))\,u_{g,q,M}$ in diagrammatic composition order, where $\operatorname{adj}(b)$ is taken under the selected tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

proof.text: Extend the ordinary adjunction to complexes and compute on singles. At degree q the equation is the ordinary adjunction unit formula; at every other degree it is the unique map from the zero object. Transport through the homotopy quotient using the unit normalization of the induced homotopy adjunction.

Apply the defining normalized equation of exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction to the homotopy single comparison followed by the single of b. Substitute the termwise transpose equation and apply localization. The remaining right-derived unit is exactly the constructed u. Unfolding the pinned comparison and the single functors gives the displayed formula, without a separate shift argument.

mathlib_searches.query: On a single complex in degree q the pinned derived tensor pullback and direct image adjunction sends a module map after the pullback comparison to its ordinary transpose followed by the right derived unit

mathlib_searches.query: The normalized derived adjunction on single complexes in degree n transposes the pullback comparison to the right derived unit
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app and derived-unit factorization lemmas; no fixed integer-degree tensor comparison/counit equation.
General homEquiv naturality and inverse identities, used in the proof; no normalized derived-module single equation.

The existing top cohomology Hom-bijection and derived unit suffice for the proof; the earlier canonical single transpose is only degree zero and uses a different comparison. No duplicate of the new integer-degree equation.

Local normalization on the upper truncation of the derived direct image. Single-complex normalization of the explicit truncated counit. Integer-degree termwise adjunction normalization.

lean.statement: theorem topEdgeSingleAdjunctionTranspose {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) (q : ℤ) (N : S.Modules) (M : T.Modules) (b : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj N ⟶ M) : let adj := @pinnedDerivedAdjunction.{u, w} _ (fun {_ _} f ↦ Scheme.Modules.canonicalTensorPullbackAdditive.{u, w} f) _ _ g let a := Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g) adj.homEquiv _ _ (pinnedModulePullbackComparisonAt g q N ≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) q).map b) = (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) q).map (a.homEquiv _ _ b) ≫ topEdgeSingleDirectImageMap g q M
